scope: Proposition 19.4 (Bounded variables) of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 136. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently large fixed N and all sufficiently large allowed R, every admissible smooth homotopy solution satisfies |f| ≤ C0/ηN , −ϵ ≤ t ≤ Z ≤ C(N), | grad f| ≤ C(N). (19.17) The constants are independent of R, the solution, and the homotopy parameter. No uniform Hessian or coefficient continuity estimate is used in obtaining these bounds.
